# sfcompute_images (Data Source)

Reads images from SF Compute (`GET /v2/images`). All pages are fetched unless `limit`, `starting_after` or `ending_before` is set.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ending_before` (String) Cursor for backward pagination.
- `id` (List of String) Filter by image ID (repeatable).
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of results to return (1-200, default 50).
- `starting_after` (String) Cursor for forward pagination (from a previous response's `cursor` field).
- `workspace` (String) Scope the returned list to a single workspace (ID, resource path, or name). Without it, the returned list spans every workspace where the caller has `Image:List` and `Image:Read` (granted at either the workspace or organization level). Public images are not included by default - request them by specifying `sfc:workspace:sfcompute:public` for the `workspace` query parameter. If omitted, the provider's `workspace` is used.

### Read-Only

- `cursor` (String)
- `data` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `has_more` (Boolean)

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `id` (String) Accepts the canonical prefix below; additional legacy prefixes are aliased for read compatibility. Writes always emit the canonical form.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether this is an sfc-provided public image.
- `name` (String)
- `resource_path` (String) A resource path for a image resource. Format: sfc:image:<account>:<workspace>:<name>.
- `sha256` (String)
- `upload_status` (String)
- `workspace` (Attributes) Workspace this image belongs to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--workspace))

<a id="nestedatt--data--workspace"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.workspace`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
